events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Flashback
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people flocked to a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. We're talking Woodstock! Which iconic performance still gives you chills?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee, in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. The King of Rock & Roll would have been 91 today. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, Nevada, in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the world lost a lyrical genius. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His words continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London in 1970, leaving an indelible mark on music. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. The guitar wizard would have been 84. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring classic tracks and its famous cover art, in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, who turns 75 today! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam G
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top tune from the Oasis legend or his solo career?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine', featuring the iconic title track, was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful as ever. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music players, in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the first iPod?
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. Who remembers painstakingly syncing their entire CD collection to one of these?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! We're celebrating 64 years of 007. Which Bond theme tune is your absolute favourite?

events.title: John Lennon's Birthday
events.blurb: Musician, singer, and songwriter John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', showcasing a diverse range of styles, in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A truly eclectic masterpiece. Which track from the double album is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in London in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. The Queen frontman would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
